38761803.finding: Subtype-WGME is a deep-learning framework that integrates whole-genome-wide multi-omics data via a multi-task encoder and was benchmarked against comparative algorithms on eight cancer datasets, outperforming them in cancer subtyping.

42255168.finding: This bibliometric review of LLMs in cancer research identifies multi-omics integration as one of the emerging research hotspots alongside LLM benchmarking, domain-specific fine-tuning, and perioperative applications.

34093987.finding: DeepOmix is a scalable, interpretable deep-learning framework for integrating multi-omics data with prior biological knowledge for cancer survival prediction, and benchmark experiments showed it outperforms five cutting-edge prediction methods.

40403730.finding: The BICCN Challenge benchmarked machine learning and feature-based methods for predicting functional cell-type-specific enhancers from cross-species multi-omics data, finding open chromatin as the strongest predictor and sequence models improving non-functional enhancer prediction.

36842969.finding: The authors systematically benchmarked 18 computational methods across 63 combinations of six omics data types (GWAS, miRNA, mRNA, microbiome, metabolome, DNA methylation) for asthma development prediction, finding Logistic Regression, MLP, and MOGONET superior.

36199022.finding: Using 15 cancer multi-omics datasets, this benchmark study compared four filter, two embedded, and two wrapper feature selection methods with SVM and random forest classifiers, finding mRMR, random forest permutation importance, and Lasso generally outperformed the others.

41335468.finding: Describes CelLink, a novel single-cell multi-omics integration method that uses multi-phase optimal transport to handle weak feature linkage and imbalanced cell populations, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on scRNA-seq, spatial proteomics, and CITE-seq data.

33402734.finding: Systematically benchmarked nine joint dimensionality reduction methods for multi-omics integration using simulated data, TCGA cancer cohorts, and single-cell data, finding intNMF best for clustering and MCIA broadly effective, with code provided in a Jupyter notebook (momix).
33402734.model: human cancer (TCGA bulk and single-cell multi-omics)

34616066.finding: Developed computational and statistical methods to integrate transcriptomic and epigenomic single-cell data from >500,000 cells of the mouse primary motor cortex, producing a reproducible cell-type atlas validated across modalities and technologies.

40880840.finding: A Primer providing a conceptual framework and apples-to-apples comparison of spatial multiplexing and omics technologies, covering experimental design, analytical platforms, image segmentation, and reproducibility considerations.

37211341.finding: Describes the PrecisionTox consortium's integration of multiple omics and comparative toxicology data across five model species (fruit flies, nematodes, water fleas, clawed frogs, zebrafish) and human cell lines to map conserved adverse outcome pathways.
37211341.model: five model species + human cell lines (multi-omics toxicology)

41251150.finding: Describes Reactome 2026 as a curated knowledgebase that has launched new analysis tools supporting multi-omics integration and customizable visualizations, alongside a redesigned web interface and chatbot.

38410680.finding: A Primer reviewing chromatin accessibility profiling methods (ATAC-seq, DNase-seq, etc.), associated bioinformatics tools, and envisioning future single-molecule, multi-omics, and spatial extensions.

40952592.finding: A review of microbiota–gut–brain axis mechanisms in neurodegenerative diseases that calls for future integration of multi-omics strategies with longitudinal cohorts and mechanistic models.
40952592.model: human microbiome–gut–brain (review across AD, PD, MS, ALS)

41589623.finding: Uses multi-omics integration comparison with functional validation in min pigs and Sting-/- mice to show that Streptococcus hyointestinalis EVs remodel macrophage polarization via the STING pathway.
41589623.model: min pigs and mice (gut microbiome + host multi-omics)

38184138.finding: A review examining the roles of genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics in myocarditis pathogenesis and arguing for the necessity of a holistic multi-omics approach.

40436252.finding: Applies advanced multi-omics integration strategies—pQTL, correlation network analysis, GSEA, and TF analyses—combining genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, and clinical data from 230 individuals to elucidate methylmalonic aciduria mechanisms.

37460560.finding: Introduces the MIHCSME metadata model combining ISA and REMBI standards to enable FAIR sharing of high-content screening imaging data, paving the way for visual omics and multi-omics integration.

39321538.finding: Combined metabolomic and transcriptomic analyses in zebrafish exposed to RDP revealed dysregulated lipid/arachidonic acid/amino acid metabolism and altered expression of genes linked to cell adhesion, gap junctions, and oxidative phosphorylation, with correlative integration of the multi-omics findings.

37116496.finding: Using an integrated multi-omics approach in aged murine liver, the study identified H3K27me3-driven broad heterochromatinization with site-specific losses at developmental transcription factor promoters, reversible upon liver regeneration.

38855253.finding: The paper proposes multi-view extensions of t-SNE, LLE and ISOMAP (notably multi-SNE) for dimensionality reduction and visualization of multi-view/multi-omics data, showing improved clustering on synthetic data and application to single-cell multi-omics.

38096184.finding: BioMOBS is presented as a multi-omics visual analytics workflow integrating two data visualization tools with an open-source molecular information database for clinically relevant pathway exploration.

40106419.finding: HemAtlas is a platform integrating multi-omics datasets (humans, mice, zebrafish, HSPC in vitro) with interactive exploration, visualization, and cross-species/cross-stage analyses for hematopoiesis.

37142594.finding: NetBID2 is a comprehensive toolkit that reverse-engineers context-specific interactomes and integrates network activity from large-scale multi-omics data to identify hidden drivers, with Viewer, Runner, and Cloud apps and 145 context-specific networks.

33849075.finding: iNetModels is an interactive database and visualization platform of Multi-Omics Biological Networks (MOBNs) linking clinical, proteomic, metabolomic, and metagenomic (oral/gut microbiome) data, plus tissue/cancer-specific gene co-expression networks.

36929070.finding: A methods chapter reviewing recent algorithms and statistical methods for deconvolution and integration of multi-omics data across genome, transcriptome, proteome, metabolome, microbiome, single-cell and spatial modalities.

41339793.finding: LOSTdb is a lung cancer platform integrating 295 multi-omics datasets (bulk RNA-seq, genomic, proteomic, methylation, scRNA-seq) with curated metadata and modules for subtype annotation, cross-search, and integrated analysis.

29718427.finding: iPath3.0 is a web-application for visualization of cellular pathways that highlights general metabolic trends in multi-omics data and supports multiple experimental conditions and time-series datasets.

29173869.finding: A perspective reviewing functional attributes of the human gut microbiome and arguing that gaps in functional knowledge require improved molecular high-throughput measurements and experimental models.

36376937.finding: In a multi-omics integration analysis of 1430+ participants, specific gut microbial genera were associated with cognitive impairment and hippocampal volume, with mediation by serum metabolites such as acetic acid.

39026781.finding: OpenPedCan extends OpenPBTA into a harmonized multi-omic dataset of 6,112 pediatric cancer patients with 60+ reproducible, dockerized modules (WGS/WXS/RNA-seq/proteomics/methylation) deployable locally, on CAVATICA, or AWS, integrated with the GMKF workflows.

38248837.finding: Compares extraction and digestion protocols (FASP vs S-Trap; methanol, Folch, Matyash) for parallel protein, metabolite, and lipid multi-omics to optimize MS-based sample preparation workflows.

41340224.finding: Describes hydrogel-based 3D co-culture platforms with cancer cell lines and biomaterials (collagen, GelMA, Matrigel, PEG) for modeling the lung cancer tumor microenvironment; does not address omics software.
41340224.model: human cell lines (A549, H1299, H460) + fibroblasts/endothelial/immune cells

39864538.finding: SurvivalML is a comprehensive platform that uses large-scale harmonized multi-omics data across 21 cancer types to discover and validate prognostic biomarkers and gene signatures, exemplified by DCLRE1B in HCC and the SCGPS glioblastoma model.
39864538.model: human solid tumors (21 TCGA cancer types; HCC, GBM cohorts)

35234253.finding: Review of emerging multi-omics and translational strategies for personalized/predictive medicine, discussing FAIR principles and integration of metabolomics with genomic and clinical data.

34979745.finding: Describes the concept of 'next-generation diagnostic pathology' that combines histomorphology with multi-omics detection, bioinformatics analysis, and AI-assisted diagnosis to produce integrated diagnostic reports.

31114869.finding: MEXPRESS is an updated web tool for interactive integration and visualization of gene expression, DNA methylation, and clinical data from TCGA, uniquely depicting methylation at precise genomic locations alongside expression.

39202397.finding: Reviews bioinformatics tools and resources (TCGA, GDC, cBioPortal, UCSC Genome Browser, GEO) for cancer biomarker discovery, noting that integrating multi-omics with network analysis and ML will be key for future biomarker work.

41054136.finding: Bibliometric/visual analysis using CiteSpace, VOSviewer, and R reveals trends in omics-based osteoporosis research across three phases from mixed-cell to single-cell studies; no new software is presented.

35639733.finding: OmicsNet 2.0 is a web platform with 2D/3D layouts that builds and analyzes multi-omics networks from gene expression, SNP, microbiome, and untargeted metabolomics lists, with an R companion (OmicsNetR) for reproducibility.
35639733.model: human inflammatory bowel disease (case study); supports genes/SNPs/taxa/metabolites

30485709.finding: sORFs.org is a public repository of ~3 million small ORFs from ribosome profiling across 78 datasets in six species, with a pipeline to rescan MS datasets for sORF-encoded polypeptides, providing a multi-omics resource and visualization tools.
30485709.model: six species (ribosome profiling + MS proteomics, 78 datasets)

36243962.finding: RABC is a multi-omics data hub for rheumatoid arthritis integrating 175 sample sets across transcriptome, epigenome, genome, and proteome with DEGs, DEMs, methylation, KEGG/GO, SNPs, eQTLs, and m6A/meta-mQTLs, plus visualization modules.

40495162.finding: Applied bidirectional Mendelian randomization, LDSC, mediation, and PheWAS across gut microbiome, inflammatory proteins, and phenome data to investigate causal links with sleep apnea.
40495162.model: human; gut microbiome, inflammatory proteomics, phenome

39909032.finding: Performed integrated multi-omics of fecal microbiome and metabolome from 165 ICB-treated patients and four public metagenomic cohorts, identifying response-associated enterotypes and the metabolite PAGln.
39909032.model: human; fecal microbiome and metabolome, cancer immunotherapy

41053825.finding: Used meta-metabolomics-guided integrated multi-omics (metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, metabolomics) to identify functional microbiome alterations in prodromal and idiopathic Parkinson's disease, visualized via the Expobiome map.

40213833.finding: Reviewed the interplay among gut microbiota, epigenetics, and environmental/dietary factors in IBD and highlighted the role of multi-omics technologies in dissecting host-microbe interactions.

35995842.finding: Integrated sputum metagenomics, metabolomics, host transcriptome and proteome from 99 COPD patients using sequential mediation analysis to link microbial metabolism with host inflammatory pathways.
35995842.model: human and mouse; airway microbiome, COPD

39020083.finding: Applied the DIABLO multi-omics integration framework to paired 16S tissue microbiome and plasma metabolome data and built supervised classifiers distinguishing early-onset from average-onset colorectal cancer.
39020083.model: human; tumor tissue microbiome and plasma metabolome, colorectal cancer

31142858.finding: Performed longitudinal multi-omics profiling (transcriptome, metabolome, cytokines, proteome, microbiome) in 106 individuals to characterize host-microbe dynamics during prediabetes and viral infection.

41482560.finding: Applied deep multi-omics phenotyping across 1,408 individuals to define a metabolome-informed obesity metric linked to adipose-microbiome interactions and validated externally.

40759968.finding: Combined mucosal quantitative microbial profiling with host epigenomics, transcriptomics, and genotyping in 56 pediatric UC patients and used machine learning on microbiome+epigenome for relapse prediction.
40759968.model: human (children); mucosal microbiome and host multi-omics, ulcerative colitis

39604623.finding: Used multi-omics profiling plus a wireless motility capsule in 61 healthy adults to link day-to-day variations in gut physiology (transit time, pH) with microbiome composition and metabolism.
39604623.model: human; gut microbiome and metabolome, healthy adults

41845564.finding: Reviewed how integrative multi-omics (metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics) connect microbial genetic potential to activity in T2D and discussed strain-resolved and annotation challenges.

38517896.finding: Applied multi-omics to mouse gut contents and host physiology after genetically activating ChAT+ or TH+ enteric neurons, showing peripheral neuronal subtypes differentially shape microbiome structure and metabolites.
38517896.model: mouse; gut microbiome and metabolome, enteric nervous system

37351171.finding: Established a urine metabolomics–peptidomics multi-omics platform and combined it with machine learning to classify DKD stages, with renal transcriptomics used to support altered pathways.
37351171.model: human (urine metabolomics + peptidomics, supported by renal transcriptomics)

39490163.finding: Used serum metabolomics and gut microbiota profiling with mediation analysis to link indoor PM2.5 components to accelerated biological aging in schizophrenia patients.

40964786.finding: Applied sparse partial least squares discriminant analysis (sPLS-DA) to integrate plasma NMR metabolomics and proteomics for predicting DKD progression in younger-onset T2D.

35432452.finding: Pre-processed and normalized miRNA/mRNA, microbiota, immune cell, metabolite and phenotype datasets for integration with the mixOmics R platform to identify discriminant features between two laying hen strains.

40650680.finding: Integrated single-cell RNA-seq (158,577 cells) with TCGA bulk RNA-seq to define malignant cell differentiation states and a multi-omics prognostic classification for papillary thyroid cancer.

41103643.finding: Combined 4D-DIA serum proteomics with LC-MS metabolomics and pathway analysis to characterize hepatic molecular changes after semaglutide treatment in T2DM-MAFLD patients.

42321664.finding: Used hdWGCNA on scRNA-seq and ten machine-learning algorithms on bulk transcriptomic data to build a T-cell exhaustion score validated in CRC cohorts.

41207909.finding: Applied FindAllMarkers, DESeq2, ssGSEA, WGCNA and 162 ML algorithm combinations to single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data to derive an immune-prognostic signature in prostate cancer.
41207909.model: human (scRNA-seq + bulk RNA-seq + genomics, prostate cancer)

42260364.finding: Applied multiGSEA for pathway enrichment and mixOmics multiview integration to combine pediatric plasma proteomics and metabolomics, comparing multi-omics signatures against single-omics classifiers.

33195430.finding: Used TCGA multi-omics data (transcriptomics, mutation, methylation) to associate NHEJ pathway genes with clinicopathological features and survival in colon cancer.

37721161.finding: Longitudinal study profiling gut microbiome and plasma metabolome in ALS and controls, using network analysis and Mendelian randomization to link microbial amplicon sequence variants to lipid metabolites.

36758521.finding: Combined metagenomic, plasma metabolomic, and clinical phenotyping analysis of ME/CFS patients identifies microbial and metabolic dysbiosis and biomarkers associated with disease duration.

37199635.finding: Integrated analysis of intestinal microbiome, fecal and serum metabolomes with clinical phenotypes in FGR pregnancies, supplemented by fecal microbiota transplantation in mice.

39039072.finding: Integrated proteogenomic analysis of 207 treatment-naïve melanomas stratifies tumors into prognosis-related subtypes and identifies PRKDC amplification as a prognostic marker.

36064406.finding: Narrative review summarizing multi-omics studies applied to prostate cancer for molecular subtyping, biomarker discovery, and treatment response assessment.

39730760.finding: Multi-omics integration of blood transcriptomics, eQTL, GWAS, and Mendelian randomization identifies age-related genes in Parkinson's disease and provides a Shiny web application for exploration.

41307322.finding: Multi-omics study of saliva and stool in periodontitis using MaAsLin2, timeOmics, mixOmics (sPLS-DA), clusterProfiler, and multi-block PLS regression for data integration across oral and gut niches.

40820799.finding: Multi-omics analysis of bone tissue from hindlimb-unloaded mice identifies glutamine catabolism-mediated suppression of monocyte apoptosis under mechanical unloading.

41368255.finding: Multi-omics framework integrating scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq with Seurat, Signac, CIBERSORT, GSVA, and GSEA to characterize metabolic-immune interactions in prostate cancer.
41368255.model: human (prostate cancer, TCGA-PRAD and public scRNA/scATAC datasets)

41055774.finding: Integration of nucleotide metabolism gene expression with UMAP, hierarchical clustering, LASSO-Cox, and pharmacogenomic data to build a 17-gene prognostic signature for medulloblastoma subtypes.

36456901.finding: Plasma proteomics and metabolomics in atrial fibrillation-induced heart failure integrated via univariate statistics, multivariate methods, and machine learning to identify enriched pathways and biomarker panels.
36456901.model: human (atrial fibrillation patients with/without heart failure)

40581657.finding: Integrated transcriptomic (miRNA/mRNA) and proteomic analysis of AD synaptosomes using DIABLO (mixOmics) to model relationships across multi-omics layers and identify synapse-associated candidates.
